items.question: How can a mind fixed on that object remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be undergoing severance at a given time.
A mind fixed on that object remains directed elsewhere in focus.
That directed focus prevents the act of cutting from affecting the mind.
items.inference: A mind fixed on that object is not subject to severance even as the body is being cut.
uncertainties: Extent to which fixation must be sustained remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that object is not cut even when being cut, so too is that mind unaffected by severance.
